name: ED door-to-provider median (minutes)
qualityNotes: Not ED length of stay; not boarding. Enterprise reads the same Beds/ED scenario stocks.

name: ED arrivals
qualityNotes: Flow total from scenario months; not a live feed.

name: ED admissions
qualityNotes: Denominator for boarding rate; distinct from inpatient admissions ledger.

name: ED boarding beyond 4 hours rate
qualityNotes: Uses emergency admissions as denominator. Hospital bed occupancy is a confounder, not an ED KPI.

name: Operational bed occupancy
qualityNotes: Period-end / period-average stock — not a flow total. ICU occupancy is a separate scope.

name: Available beds
qualityNotes: Stock, not a daily average of availability minutes.

name: Blocked beds
qualityNotes: Reduces usable capacity even when occupancy looks manageable.

name: ICU credentialed nurse-hour gap
qualityNotes: ICU-owned scope. Distinct from Strategy enterprise staffing gap (P1-005).

name: ICU required nurse hours
qualityNotes: Must match Strategy.icuRequiredHours when scopes are ICU.

name: ICU boarding hours
qualityNotes: Distinct from ED boarding beyond 4 hours.

name: ICU bed occupancy
qualityNotes: ICU unit inventory — not general ward occupancy.

name: Inpatient admissions
qualityNotes: Includes ED-sourced and direct admissions; not ED visit volume.

name: Inpatient median length of stay
qualityNotes: Not bed occupancy; not ED LOS.

name: Inpatient census
qualityNotes: Census basis documented on IPD view; not a rate.

name: OPD visits
qualityNotes: Attended appointment volume — not booked slots.

name: OPD median wait (minutes)
qualityNotes: Distinct from appointment booking lead time.

name: Appointment no-show rate
qualityNotes: Booked cohort; cancelled slots follow a separate recovery lifecycle.

name: Appointment slot fill rate
qualityNotes: Capacity fill — not attendance.

name: OR utilization
qualityNotes: Uncapped; overtime appears when used > staffed. Strategy reads the same value.

name: Surgeries completed
qualityNotes: Distinct from scheduled requests and cancellations.

name: Surgery cancellation rate
qualityNotes: Operational cancellation — not clinical outcome.

name: Laboratory pending validation
qualityNotes: Test-item grain — not order grain.

name: Laboratory median TAT (hours)
qualityNotes: Analytical + validation clock; STAT vs routine mix confounds.

name: Radiology imaging backlog
qualityNotes: Access backlog — not unsigned report queue.

name: Radiology median report TAT (hours)
qualityNotes: Reporting clock — distinct from request-to-exam access wait.

name: Diagnostic scanner utilization
qualityNotes: Equipment utilization — not radiologist productivity.

name: Pharmacy dispense rate
qualityNotes: Order grain — not line or administration grain.

name: Pharmacy median TAT (minutes)
qualityNotes: Workflow mix confounds (STAT vs routine).

name: Pharmacy stockout SKUs
qualityNotes: Pharmacy inventory scope — not Supply Chain clinical consumption units.

name: Net patient revenue
qualityNotes: Authoritative revenue lineage for Strategy (P0-001). Revenue ≠ profit.

name: Gross denial rate
qualityNotes: Claim-count rate — not denial by value.

name: Days in AR
qualityNotes: Stock/flow hybrid; not cash collection rate.

name: Strategy recognized net revenue
qualityNotes: Must equal rcm.net_patient_revenue (P0-001). No independent Strategy revenue ledger.

name: Operating contribution
qualityNotes: Costs are synthetic (not ERP). Distinct from CM Rate %.

name: Contribution margin rate
qualityNotes: Rate (%) — never confuse with Operating Contribution SAR (P1-006).

name: Enterprise staffing gap (hours)
qualityNotes: Distinct from ICU credentialed gap. Surplus ≠ automatic ICU fill (P1-005).

name: Strategy-mirrored ICU staffing gap
qualityNotes: Must equal icu.staffing_gap_hours — mirror, not a second calculation.

name: Supply availability
qualityNotes: Must stay in [0,1] (P1-001). Monthly chart series use 0–100 percent points.

name: Supplier on-time delivery
qualityNotes: On-time ⊆ received. Must stay in [0,1].

name: Critical stockouts
qualityNotes: Operational constraint signal for clinical throughput.

name: Days of supply (units)
qualityNotes: Null when demand is zero (P1-002). Units cover — not SAR value cover.

name: CLABSI rate (per 1000 CL days)
qualityNotes: Null/missing when device-days are zero (P2-001). Not patient-level causality.

name: Overdue high-risk CAPA actions
qualityNotes: Governance backlog — not infection incidence.

name: Validated safety event rate
qualityNotes: Reporting culture confounds incidence interpretation.

name: Overall patient satisfaction
qualityNotes: Survey cohort — not clinical outcome. Correlation ≠ causation with wait times.

name: Enterprise net patient revenue
qualityNotes: Mirror of RCM — not a third revenue ledger.

name: Enterprise operating contribution
qualityNotes: Mirror of Strategy — not an independent CM model.
